method_note: Dry run fixture: every candidate of the run read; five promoted, three rejected, one duplicate and one deferred. Optimism: the Climate Change Committee report threatens SI6 and the inquiry could go either way. Mainstream: one promotion, the BBC report, is not government or a regulator. Streetlight: SI9, SI11 and SI12 have low or no scanability and stay blind spots.
